summary: Minimal, correct fix that gives each deep-copied field its own error_messages dict, matching the existing shallow-copy idiom used for validators just below it. Resolves the shared-dictionary bug exactly as the issue describes.

issues.description: Uses a shallow dict.copy() rather than deepcopy, so nested mutable message values would still be shared. In practice error_messages values are immutable strings/lazy proxies, and this matches Django's own convention (validators[:] on the next line), so it is not a real defect.
